items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: I worked there with Milt Hinton and Eddie Shaughnessy and so many guys.

ctx.x: Yeah. So you did some work with the Jamey Aebersold camps, so I want to know, like Jamey says, can anyone improvise?

Well I think they can. I was talking about that — I watched a beautiful documentary this morning called “Moonlight Sonata” and it was all about a deaf child who got cochlear implants when he was young, and he got to hear, and he ended up performing. And it was a beautiful documentary. And I was telling my wife, I said, you know I used to do that with my classical players, and I said Jamey used to do that too. Even though you’re working on a certain performance piece in a lesson, you should always let the student…
Nice. Do your brothers, do you get on the phone with your brothers and trade band stories or when you — the rare moments you’re all together?
